tasks.source: def answer : (x : Nat) -> (y : Nat) -> (z : Nat) -> Nat := synth "A lab receives x cartons and rejects y whole cartons. If rejection exceeds the delivery, no cartons survive. Each surviving carton supplies z sample tubes. Return the number of tubes supplied."
candidates: fun (x : Nat) (y : Nat) (z : Nat) => natMul (natSub x y) z
fun (x : Nat) (y : Nat) (z : Nat) => natSub x (natMul y z)

tasks.source: def answer : (x : Nat) -> (y : Nat) -> (z : Nat) -> Nat := synth "There are x printed sheets. Every sheet starts with y labels, and z labels on each sheet are spoiled. A sheet contributes zero usable labels when z is at least y. How many usable labels do all the sheets contribute?"

fun (x : Nat) (y : Nat) (z : Nat) => natMul x (natSub y z)

tasks.source: def answer : (x : Nat) -> (y : Nat) -> (z : Nat) -> Nat := synth "Open x bundles containing y cards apiece and combine all the cards into one pile. Discard z cards from that combined pile, or the entire pile if fewer than z exist. Return the number of cards left."

fun (x : Nat) (y : Nat) (z : Nat) => natMul x (natSub y z)

tasks.source: def answer : (x : Nat) -> (y : Nat) -> (z : Nat) -> Nat := synth "A badge tray holds x red badges and y blue badges. Remove z badges of each color separately; a color with fewer than z is emptied. Count the choices of one surviving red badge together with one surviving blue badge."

tasks.source: def answer : (x : Nat) -> (y : Nat) -> Nat := synth "For each of y projects, list every assignment of a lead reviewer and a different backup reviewer from the same x people. Swapping the two people makes a different assignment. Count project-and-assignment entries across all lists."

tasks.source: def answer : (x : Nat) -> (y : Nat) -> (z : Nat) -> Nat := synth "At each of z sessions, every one of x hosts sends a greeting to every one of y visitors, and each visitor sends a separate reply greeting to each host. Count individual sent greetings over all sessions."
